_why: The bare-name strip has NO correct domain. With a single relation in scope a qualifier is unnecessary, so stripping it adds nothing. With several, stripping makes the reference ambiguous and picks arbitrarily. So the fallback is either redundant or wrong — never right. It fires only when correct resolution ALREADY failed, which means the qualifier names a relation not in scope or the field does not exist; both are errors. Instead it returns FieldValue::Null, which is indistinguishable from a legitimate SQL NULL, converting a binding failure into a data value. Its three sequencing blockers are closed: #1833 and #1888 converged the layout spellings, #1835 gave build_combined_row_values its stream-side qualifier (stream_table_join.rs:670 now takes stream_alias: Option<&str>, cached_alias_context wired). With the layout authority emitting every legal spelling, a qualified reference that fails exact lookup is a bug, not something to guess around. Do NOT measure first — the issue's own acceptance asked for a firing count, but a count cannot justify the strip: non-zero means it is silently answering wrongly, zero means it is dead. Delete either way.

anchors._note: the THIRD site flagged on the issue — audit whether it shares the strip behaviour; delete it too if so, report if not.
production caller 1 of 3 — must propagate the new Result

blast_radius._note: Gate-style literal count over src/ tests/ examples/. It over-counts: it matches resolve_columns (window_v2 strategies), resolve_column_ref, resolve_column_value and resolve_column_ref_or_err, which are different symbols. The numbers that actually bound the work: exactly THREE production callers of `.resolve_column(` in src/ (hash_join.rs:1134, evaluator.rs:122, evaluator.rs:131 — the last is the system-column path and is exempt), and ~23 `.resolve_column(` call sites in tests/ across 4 files (p4_bare_name_strip_counters_test.rs, event_time_preservation_test.rs, temporal_comparison_test.rs, lazy_decode_test.rs). Verify with `grep -rn '\.resolve_column(' src/` — 3 hits excluding the definitions — before starting. The signature change to Result is the bulk of the work, not the two-site deletion.

grammar_reference._note: System columns (_timestamp,_offset,_partition,_event_time,_window_start,_window_end) are EXEMPT by design and are handled before the strip — they must keep working unchanged.

tests._note: absent_column_distinguishable_from_present_null is the acceptance bar that matters: today both are FieldValue::Null. After this they must differ. temporal_comparison_test.rs:200 asserts resolve_column("m.price") == Float(100.0) on a record holding only bare `price` — that test PINS THE BUG and must be rewritten to assert the error, not deleted.

stop_conditions: more than 10 existing tests break — STOP and report the list with a one-line classification each (pinning-the-bug vs genuine regression)

a shipped demo/example query stops working — STOP and report the query; that means the layout authority is not emitting a spelling it should, which is a #1833/#1888 gap, not a reason to keep the strip
the `right_` JOIN prefix fallback also needs deleting to make tests pass — STOP and report; it is a different mechanism (layout spelling, not qualifier stripping) and is OUT OF SCOPE here
